answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 16206 Country: United Kingdom Title: is there a limit on the time that we have to fast, because here in the uk, the fast is over 16 hours and my children find this hard. is there a fatwa on this please? a student from delhi told us that there is a fatwa on the time limit to fasting,i.e after 12 hours you may open the fast. Is this true? we have never heard this before. Question: is there a limit on the time that we have to fast, because here in the uk, the fast is over 16 hours and my children find this hard. is there a fatwa on this please? a student from delhi told us that there is a fatwa on the time limit to fasting,i.e after 12 hours you may open the fast. Is this true? we have never heard this before. Answer ID: 16206 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1784/1437/D=1430) There is only one limit for all places, which is mentioned in the Quran that sawm should continue from appearance of true dawn to the sunset. وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الأبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الأسْوَدِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا الصِّيَامَ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ (2:187) There may be difference as per the season and place, so if the day is 16 hour long in your country, you should keep the full day from rise of true dawn to sunset. What the student said is baseless and unauthentic. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
